description.en: Saudi Arabia is a large monarchy on the Arabian Peninsula, bordered by the Red Sea to the west and the Persian Gulf to the east. It is one of the world's most oil-rich nations and the most important religious center in Islam.
description.zh: Saudi Arabia是位於阿拉伯半島的大型君主制國家，西臨紅海，東接波斯灣，是中東地區面積最大的國家之一。沙烏地阿拉伯擁有全球最豐富的石油資源之一，同時也是伊斯蘭教最重要的宗教中心。

seoText.en: Explore quick facts about Saudi Arabia — population, land area, capital city, and a short overview. Saudi Arabia is a key Middle Eastern state and home to Islam's two holiest cities.
seoText.zh: 快速了解沙烏地阿拉伯的基本資料：人口、面積、首都與簡短概述。沙烏地阿拉伯是中東核心國家，也是全球主要石油出口國與伊斯蘭教兩大聖城所在地。

list: 位於阿拉伯半島核心地帶
伊斯蘭教兩大聖城所在地
中東最具影響力國家之一
zh.text:
現代沙烏地阿拉伯於1932年建立，由沙烏地（Saudi）王室統治至今。由於石油產業快速發展，沙國在20世紀後期成為全球最富有的能源國家之一。

近年沙國積極推動「願景2030（Vision 2030）」改革，希望降低對石油依賴，發展觀光、科技與新產業。

list: Located at the heart of the Arabian Peninsula
Home to Islam's two holiest cities
One of the most influential countries in the Middle East
en.text:
Modern Saudi Arabia was established in 1932 and has been ruled by the House of Saud ever since. Driven by rapid development in the oil industry, the nation became one of the world's wealthiest energy powers in the late 20th century.

In recent years, Saudi Arabia has actively promoted the "Vision 2030" reform plan, aiming to reduce dependence on oil and develop tourism, technology, and new industries.

zh.text:
沙烏地阿拉伯國土面積約 215 萬平方公里，是中東地區最大國家之一。

境內大部分為沙漠與乾燥高原，其中魯卜哈利沙漠（Rub' al Khali，即空域沙漠）為世界最大連續沙漠之一。

list: Bordered by the Red Sea to the west and Persian Gulf to the east
en.text:
With an area of approximately 2.15 million square kilometers, Saudi Arabia is one of the largest countries in the Middle East.

The interior is largely dominated by deserts and arid plateaus, with the Rub' al Khali (Empty Quarter) being one of the largest continuous sand deserts in the world.

zh.text:
沙國氣候炎熱乾燥，夏季部分地區氣溫可超過45°C。

沿海地區濕度較高，而內陸沙漠日夜溫差明顯。水資源稀缺是重要自然限制之一。

en.text:
Saudi Arabia has a hot and dry climate, with summer temperatures in some regions exceeding 45°C.

Coastal areas experience higher humidity, while inland deserts have significant temperature variations between day and night. Water scarcity is a major natural constraint.

zh.text:
沙烏地人口主要集中於利雅德（Riyadh）、吉達（Jeddah）與東部石油城市。

由於經濟發展需要，大量外籍勞工來自南亞、東南亞與阿拉伯國家。

en.text:
The population is primarily concentrated in Riyadh, Jeddah, and eastern oil cities.

Due to economic development needs, a massive number of expatriate workers come from South Asia, Southeast Asia, and other Arab nations.

zh.text:
沙烏地阿拉伯擁有全球最大石油公司之一沙烏地阿美（Saudi Aramco）。

石油長期支撐國家財政與社會福利，但近年政府積極發展金融、觀光、娛樂與科技產業，以降低對能源依賴。

list: Oil exports are the core of the economy
en.text:
Saudi Arabia is home to Saudi Aramco, one of the world's largest oil companies.

Oil has long supported state finances and social welfare, but recently the government has actively developed finance, tourism, entertainment, and tech industries to reduce energy reliance.

zh.text:
沙烏地阿拉伯由沙烏地（Saudi）王室統治，國王同時為國家元首與政府最高權力核心。

法律制度深受伊斯蘭教法（Sharia）影響，宗教在政治與社會中具有高度地位。

list: Long-standing rule by the House of Saud
en.text:
Saudi Arabia is ruled by the House of Saud, with the King serving as both the head of state and the core of government power.

The legal system is deeply influenced by Islamic law (Sharia), and religion holds a highly elevated status in both politics and society.

zh.text:
沙國社會長期較為保守，但近年推動女性駕駛、娛樂活動與觀光開放等改革。

大型城市現代化程度高，但宗教與傳統價值仍深刻影響社會文化。

en.text:
Saudi society has long been relatively conservative, though recent reforms have allowed women to drive and opened up entertainment and tourism.

Major cities are highly modernized, yet religion and traditional values continue to deeply shape social culture.

zh.text:
沙烏地擁有麥加（Mecca）與麥地那（Medina）兩大伊斯蘭聖城，每年吸引大量穆斯林朝覲（Hajj）。

阿拉伯語為官方語言，傳統詩歌、音樂與沙漠文化在歷史上具有重要地位。

en.text:
Saudi Arabia is home to Mecca and Medina, the two holiest cities in Islam, attracting millions of Muslims for the annual pilgrimage (Hajj).

Arabic is the official language, and traditional poetry, music, and desert culture hold significant historical importance.

list: 社會改革與保守文化平衡
zh.text:
沙國近年積極推動大型開發計畫，如新未來城（NEOM）計畫，以建立新經濟模式。

同時，社會改革速度與傳統宗教文化之間的平衡，也是國內重要議題。

list: Balancing social reform and conservative culture
en.text:
Saudi Arabia has recently pushed large-scale development projects, such as the future city NEOM, to build a new economic model.

Meanwhile, finding a balance between the pace of social reform and traditional religious culture remains a key domestic issue.

list: 利雅德（Riyadh）—— 首都與政治金融中心
吉達（Jeddah）—— 紅海沿岸商業港口
麥加（Mecca）—— 伊斯蘭教最神聖城市
禁寺（Masjid al-Haram）—— 伊斯蘭世界最重要清真寺
zh.text:
利雅德（Riyadh）為現代化政治與金融核心，而吉達（Jeddah）則是重要港口與商業城市。

麥加（Mecca）與禁寺（Masjid al-Haram）在全球穆斯林宗教生活中具有最高地位。

list: Jeddah — Commercial port city on the Red Sea
Mecca — The holiest city in Islam
Masjid al-Haram — The most important mosque in the Islamic world
en.text:
Riyadh serves as the modernized political and financial hub, while Jeddah is a major port and commercial center.

Mecca and Masjid al-Haram hold the highest status in the religious lives of Muslims globally.

zh.text:
沙烏地長期在全球能源市場中具有關鍵影響力，石油政策會直接影響國際能源價格。

同時，沙國在中東地區政治、安全與宗教事務中具有重要地位。

list: Major regional power in the Middle East
Close security cooperation with the US
en.text:
Saudi Arabia has long held crucial influence in the global energy market, with its oil policies directly impacting international prices.

Additionally, the country plays an important role in Middle Eastern political, security, and religious affairs.

zh.text:
沙烏地阿拉伯與台灣維持非官方經貿關係，石油與石化產品為重要合作領域。

近年雙方在科技、工程與商業交流方面亦逐漸增加。

list: Important trade in energy and petrochemicals
High potential for cooperation in the Middle East market
en.text:
Saudi Arabia and Taiwan maintain unofficial economic ties, with oil and petrochemicals being key areas of cooperation.

In recent years, exchanges in technology, engineering, and business have also been gradually increasing between the two.

list: 伊斯蘭教兩大聖城所在地
中東地區戰略核心國家
Home to Islam's two holiest cities
Strategic core nation in the Middle East
Vision 2030 as a vital reform plan

text.en: Mecca — The holiest city in Islam, attracting millions of pilgrims annually
text.zh: 麥加（Mecca）——伊斯蘭教最神聖的城市，每年吸引數百萬朝聖者

text.en: Saudi Aramco — One of the world's most valuable companies and a global energy giant
text.zh: 沙烏地阿美（Saudi Aramco）——全球市值最高企業之一與能源巨擘

text.en: Rub' al Khali — The 'Empty Quarter', the world's largest continuous sand desert
text.zh: 魯卜哈利沙漠（Rub' al Khali，即空域沙漠）——世界最大的連續沙丘沙漠

text.en: Vision 2030 — A sweeping reform plan to diversify the economy and modernize society
text.zh: 願景2030（Vision 2030）——旨在經濟多元化與社會現代化的全面改革計畫

text.en: Al-Masjid an-Nabawi — The Prophet's Mosque in Medina, the second holiest site in Islam
text.zh: 先知清真寺（Al-Masjid an-Nabawi）——位於麥地那（Medina），伊斯蘭教第二大聖地
